seo.title: Industrial Argon Gas Supplier | Sunrise Gases
seo.description: Industrial argon gas for welding, metal fabrication, and heat treatment. Supplied as compressed gas. Manufactured in Nagpur.

faq.question: What argon cylinder sizes do you supply?
faq.answer: Compressed argon cylinders in 10L, 20L, and 47L sizes, plus liquid (cryogenic) argon on request.

faq.question: What purity is industrial argon?
faq.answer: Industrial grade argon at 99.9% purity for MIG/TIG welding shielding and metal fabrication.

faq.question: Do you supply argon-based gas mixtures?
faq.answer: Yes. We blend argon with carbon dioxide (Agroshield) and nitrogen (Argonite) to customer-specified ratios.

faq.question: Do you supply welding gas in Nagpur?
faq.answer: Yes. We supply argon (99.9%) for MIG/TIG welding shielding, plus argon-CO2 (Agroshield) and argon-nitrogen (Argonite) mixtures for fabrication shops across Nagpur.

faq.question: Can I refill argon cylinders?
faq.answer: Yes. Argon cylinder refill in 10L, 20L, and 47L sizes is available from our Nagpur facility, 24 hours a day.
